fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2017 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $33.5 million for the 2017 year.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in many years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense for 2017 increased $86.0 million, or 33.4 percent, compared with 2016. Additionally, there was an 8.0 percent increase in system fuel gallons consumed due to an increase in system capacity of 10.0 percent. [Derived: 172.8M × 1.080 = 186.6M gallons]
